text: Never waste a one lakh rupee bonus. Two friends, same money, ten years later.
Arun and Bala both got a one lakh rupee bonus, on the same day.
Arun chased the hype. Crypto tips, option trades, and promises to double his money fast.
One loss led to another. A bigger bet, then a loan, then a credit card bill, and then the EMIs.
Bala did something boring. He bought a Nifty fifty index fund, a tiny slice of fifty big companies.
He kept an emergency fund first, and spread the rest across shares, debt and a little gold.
Then he waited. At twelve percent a year, one lakh doubles in about six years, and becomes three point one lakh in ten.
Ten years later. Bala has three point one lakh. And Arun? Like ninety one percent of F and O traders, he lost money.
The hare runs fast, but the tortoise wins. Time in the market beats timing the market.
So, which friend are you? Save this, and follow for more money stories.
